title: 1.47.0: job worktrees outside the root by default; field lessons 343, 345, 348, 351–356
head: swarm-1.47.0-pr
body:
## What
- A checker reports when a vendored core package needs a runtime package that is neither vendored nor a direct dependency. (lesson 343)
- The shared contract template records which existing rule accepts externally checked values; scheduler-specific resource rules stay with their consumer. (lesson 345)
- The existing manual-review hold and three-field handoff are documented; green checks do not authorize a held merge. (lesson 348)
- Bounded open scopes let jobs edit tracked files in selected directories, and a warning flags restrictive prompts with too few declared outputs. (lesson 351)
- The health report checks an optional tool list and shows reinstall guidance without running it. (lesson 352)
- Jobs prepare narrow cache write access and receive a warning before dispatch when the cache is not writable. (lesson 353)
- One retry is allowed after three verified local passes and a passing base check, and a flake is recorded only after fresh CI succeeds. (lesson 354)
- Mutant review warns when another call may still preserve the effect of a removed call. (lesson 355)
- Design-only jobs are told to read and search without running tests or installs; sandbox test failures do not block them. (lesson 356)
- New job worktrees are created outside the repository root by default; an explicit setting keeps the old layout, and saved older paths remain readable.

## Speed
